squad.name: Arsen Zakharyan
squad.extract: Arsen Norayrovich Zakharyan is a Russian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for La Liga club Real Sociedad and the Russia national team.

squad.name: Mikel Goti
squad.extract: Mikel Goti López is a Spanish footballer who plays for Córdoba CF, on loan from Real Sociedad. Mainly an attacking midfielder, he can also play as a winger.

squad.name: Brais Méndez
squad.extract: Brais Méndez Portela is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for La Liga club Real Sociedad.

squad.name: Luka Sučić
squad.extract: Luka Sučić is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for La Liga club Real Sociedad. Born in Austria, he plays for the Croatia national team.

squad.name: Pablo Marín
squad.extract: Pablo Marín Tejada is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Real Sociedad.

squad.name: Jon Martín
squad.extract: Jon Martín Vicente is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Real Sociedad.

squad.name: Iñaki Rupérez
squad.extract: Iñaki Rupérez Urtasun is a Spanish footballer who plays as a right-back for Real Sociedad.

squad.name: Jon Pacheco
squad.extract: Jon Pacheco Dozagarat is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Deportivo Alavés, on loan from Real Sociedad.

squad.name: Javi López
squad.refinement: left-back for La Liga club Real Oviedo
squad.extract: Javier "Javi" López Carballo is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for La Liga club Real Oviedo, on loan from Real Sociedad.

squad.name: Carlos Fernández
squad.extract: Carlos Fernández Luna is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward for CD Mirandés, on loan from Real Sociedad.
